text: The cashier says: no phone number, no bill.
Consumer law lists not issuing a bill for goods sold as an unfair trade practice.
And G S T invoice rules don't ask for your phone number at all.
Loyalty points or an e-bill are extras; sharing your number for those is your choice.
Say politely: a printed bill without my number, please. Still refused? Call 1 9 1 5.
